extracted.intended_audience: stakeholders and potential litigants (public, local governments, environmental groups, attorneys) interested in FHWA/Caltrans highway project decisions
extracted.subtask_description: Federal Register notice announcing final agency actions for a Caltrans highway project (FHWA on behalf of Caltrans), including legal deadlines, applicable authorities, project description, and document availability.

rubrics_metrics.name: Judicial review filing deadline
rubrics_metrics.description: A claim seeking judicial review of the Federal agency actions on the highway project will be barred unless the claim is filed on or before October 31, 2024.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If the Federal law that authorizes judicial review of a claim provides a time period of less than 150 days for filing such claim, then that shorter time period still applies. The notice therefore fixes the outer filing date for claims under 23 U.S.C. 139(l)(1) and warns potential claimants to verify shorter statutory limits where applicable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Applicability under 23 U.S.C. 139(l)(1)
rubrics_metrics.description: The FHWA, on behalf of Caltrans, is advising the public of final agency actions subject to 23 U.S.C. 139(l)(1).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The notice applies to all Federal agency decisions as of the issuance date of the notice and signals that those final actions are the subject of the statutory limitations on judicial review set out in 23 U.S.C. 139(l)(1).

rubrics_metrics.name: Availability of environmental decision documents (FEA and FONSI)
rubrics_metrics.description: The actions by the Federal agencies, and the laws under which such actions were taken, are described in the Final Environmental Assessment (FEA) and the Finding of No Significant Impact (FONSI) for the project, approved on April 30, 2024.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The FEA, FONSI, and other project records are available by contacting Caltrans at the provided address and can be viewed and downloaded from the project website (link provided). This informs where the administrative record and supporting analyses can be obtained for review or litigation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Project description and purpose required in notice
rubrics_metrics.description: Caltrans proposes to construct improvements consisting of a High Occupancy Toll (HOT) 3+ lane in each direction with direct connectors, pedestrian/bicycle facilities, park-n-ride, and Intelligent Transportation System (ITS) elements along I-80 and US-50 ... Total length of the project is 20.8 miles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The notice states the project's purpose: to ease congestion and improve freeway operation to support reliable transport of goods and services throughout the region. Notices should include sufficient description (location, features, purpose, EA identifier EA 03-3H900) to identify the action and its objectives.

rubrics_metrics.name: Contact information for further information
rubrics_metrics.description: Provides name, title, office address, office hours, telephone, and email for a Caltrans contact (Robert Wall, Branch Chief, Caltrans North Region Office of Environmental Management).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Notices must include a clear point of contact with hours and means of communication so interested parties can obtain documents or ask questions (telephone and email included).

rubrics_metrics.name: Statement of laws, regulations, and executive orders considered
rubrics_metrics.description: This notice applies to all Federal agency decisions ... including but not limited to: Council on Environmental Quality Regulations; National Environmental Policy Act of 1969; Clean Air Act; Endangered Species Act; National Historic Preservation Act; Clean Water Act (sections 319, 401, and 404); Federal Land Policy and Management Act (Paleontological Resources); Noise Control Act; Safe Drinking Water Act; Executive Orders (11990, 13112, 13186, 11988, 12898); Fish and Wildlife Coordination Act; Migratory Bird Treaty Act; Wetlands Mitigation Banks provisions; Surface Transportation and Uniform Relocation Act section 130; DOT Executive Order 5650.2—Floodplain Management and Protection; Rivers and Harbors Appropriation Act sections 9 and 10; Title VI of the Civil Rights Act.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The notice identifies the statutory and regulatory authorities under which actions were taken, signaling which legal requirements and environmental protections were considered; listing these authorities helps define the legal scope of the decision and what statutory obligations were addressed in the administrative record.

rubrics_metrics.name: Public comment status
rubrics_metrics.description: Comments are no longer being accepted. See DATES for details.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The notice communicates that the administrative comment period has closed and provides the deadline information (DATES section) — important for when challenges or supplemental submissions are no longer timely.

rubrics_metrics.name: Delegation/assumption of environmental responsibilities (23 U.S.C. 327)
rubrics_metrics.description: Effective July 1, 2007, the FHWA assigned, and the California Department of Transportation (Caltrans) assumed, environmental responsibilities for this project pursuant to 23 U.S.C. 327.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Notices should state any delegated authorities or assumed responsibilities under statute (here, Caltrans assuming FHWA environmental responsibilities), which affects who performed environmental review and who is the relevant administrative actor for decisions and records.

rubrics_metrics.name: Types of actions announced (licenses, permits, approvals)
rubrics_metrics.description: The actions relate to a proposed highway project ... Those actions grant licenses, permits, and approvals for the project.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The notice must identify the kinds of agency decisions made (e.g., issuance of licenses/permits/approvals) so readers know what concrete administrative actions are final and subject to statutory review limitations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Document identification and Federal Register metadata
rubrics_metrics.description: Document Citation 89 FR 47683; Document Number 2024-12057; Document Type Notice; Pages 47683-47684; Publication Date 06/03/2024; FR Doc. 2024-12057; billing code.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Federal Register notices include formal metadata (citation, document number, pages, dates) and links to the official PDF on govinfo.gov; users are advised to consult the official edition for legal research and rely on the PDF for the authoritative text.
